case: JSON and XLSX serialization of computed COALESCE results over STRICT ANY
contract: The computed COALESCE result retains conservative fallback metadata while native typeof() confirms INTEGER, REAL, fallback TEXT, stored TEXT, BLOB and tag-prefix-shaped TEXT rows.
The result-file writer stores INTEGER and REAL results as numeric XLSX cells and fallback/stored/tag-prefix text and BLOB's \x00ff representation as shared strings.
JSON result-file output represents INTEGER/REAL as JSON numbers, fallback/stored/tag-prefix text and BLOB encoding as JSON strings, and includes the runtime storage-class text.
The workbook has no formula cells; source SQL NULL produces the explicit fallback TEXT cell, while the existing CSV import path verifies native destination storage classes and exact BLOB bytes.
This proves computed COALESCE JSON value shapes and XLSX cell kinds; spreadsheet-application re-import, other computed-expression shapes and installed editing remain open.
